explanation: It moved from the grass of Kooyong to a new hard-court centre at Flinders Park, later renamed Melbourne Park. The US Open had left grass for clay in 1975.

claims.text: The Australian Open moved from grass courts at Kooyong to hard courts at Flinders Park in 1988.
The US Open moved from grass to clay in 1975 and to hard courts in 1978; the French Open is played on clay and Wimbledon on grass.
Flinders Park was later renamed Melbourne Park.
